title: fix(share-links): the share page names the object by its label and leaves off hidden fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3T2gwH6MWTYde4qF8edEDN)_

Fixes #33552

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 打开分享链接的访客,页头现在显示对象的显示名(按访客语言),不再显示内部名;对象标记为隐藏的字段也不再列出。
- 属于分享链接落地页体验修整,替每个收到分享链接的人解决「看到内部名、看到隐藏列」的问题。
- 出错时访客看到的是对象内部名或原始显示名,或多出一行隐藏字段;都不影响数据,可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## What changes

- `@objectstack/types` `buildShareLinkResolveAnswer` (the one builder both mounts of `GET /api/v1/share-links/{token}/resolve` serve) now answers:
  - `link.object_label`: the shared object's label in the request's locale. The locale is the `Accept-Language` top tag, else the i18n service's default locale, as the meta door reads it.
    - The label is translated by `translateObject` over the served label, with the inputs the meta door hands it for an object: the resolve options `metaTranslateOptions` builds (locale, declared fallback, and `sourceLocale` before `defaultLocale` as the authored language), and `packagedBase`, the object's packaged declaration, read through the request's metadata protocol (`getPackagedObjectBase`, the accessor the meta door's `packagedObjectBaseOf` reads for an object).
    - A renamed object therefore keeps its rename, rather than getting the bundle's translation of its old label (ADR-0029 D9.2a).
    - No `pairBundle` is passed. An `object` is extend-only (ADR-0146 D10; `servedOverrideBaseOf` answers none for it), so the meta door hands the object translator no pair catalog either, and a `.custom` pair's translation of the label reaches both through the deployment bundle.
    - With no service, no entry for the locale, or a throwing service, the served label is served. A protocol that cannot answer is read as no baseline known. An object with no label carries no key.
  - `fields[NAME].hidden: true` for a field the object declares hidden, including the injected `organization_id` / `owning_business_unit_id` / `queue` columns, which are hidden at their source. No other field carries the key.
- Both producers pass the request's `Accept-Language`, the i18n service and the metadata protocol:
  - `plugin-sharing`: `registerShareLinkRoutes` gains optional `i18n` and `protocol` resolvers, which `SharingServicePlugin` wires to the kernel's `i18n` and `protocol` services, resolved per request.
  - The runtime dispatcher twin, `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts`: `deps.resolveService(context, 'i18n')` and `deps.resolveService(context, 'protocol')`.
- L2 S1 (done): both public routes (`/resolve` and `/messages`) on both mounts answer `Vary: X-Share-Password, X-Share-Password-Encoding, Accept-Language`, from the new `SHARE_LINK_PUBLIC_VARY` constant (`@objectstack/types`). Before, they sent only the two password headers. The two routes' docblocks name the third header.
- Console share page (`ui/apps/console`):
  - The header reads `Shared LABEL`, falling back to `object_name`.
  - `SharedRecordFields` leaves off a field the projection marks hidden. That is the record panel's rule (`RecordDetailPanel` filters `schemaFields[name].hidden`).
  - `shareRequestHeaders` states the `html` element's `lang` attribute as `Accept-Language`, the same source `createAuthenticatedFetch` uses, so the label matches the page's UI language.
- The runtime dispatcher twin is in scope by seat ruling, because this route has two producers. `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts` (cloud's designed primary surface) and its both-mounts harness `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-field-projection.test.ts` are part of this change. Both mounts build the answer through the one builder.
- The key name is settled by seat ruling as `link.object_label`, beside `link.object_name`.
- No `packages/spec/src/**` edit: the HTTP answer shape is declared in `@objectstack/types` only. `ResolveShareLinkResult` in spec contracts is the service result, and this PR does not change it.

## Tests

- `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` adds a top-level describe with five cases:
  - a hidden field reports `hidden: true` and a shown one carries no key;
  - a zh-CN request gets the translated label;
  - the declared label stands with no service, with an uncovered locale, and with a throwing service;
  - the i18n default locale is used when no header is sent;
  - an unlabelled object carries no `object_label`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-field-projection.test.ts` runs on both mounts over real ObjectQL, SQLite and ShareLinkService:
  - zh-CN gives the translated label; `en-US` and no header give the declared label;
  - an authored hidden field and the injected `queue` column report hidden;
  - both mounts serve equal data under a zh-CN request;
  - a code extension's rename of a packaged object keeps the rename under zh-CN, though the bundle translates the packaged label, with a control showing the unrenamed object is translated.
- `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` also pins the rename against `packagedBase`, the translated unrenamed label, and a throwing protocol read as no baseline.
- The `Vary` pins per mount now read the three headers: the dispatcher twin in `share-links-public-cache-headers.test.ts` and `share-links-password-encoding.test.ts`, the plugin route in `share-link-password.test.ts`. The two runtime harnesses import `@objectstack/metadata` at module top, as `check:test-source-alias` prescribes.
- Console:
  - `SharedRecordPage.systemFields-33346.test.tsx`: a hidden non-system field is not listed; the header shows the label; an absent label falls back to the name.
  - `shared-record-shape.test.ts`: the `Accept-Language` header follows the `html` element's `lang` attribute.

## Acceptance notes

- Field labels in the projection stay the authored ones, as before. This card asked only for the object label in the request locale. The object label is translated without the `/meta` packaged-base and pair-bundle overlay inputs, as the other non-`/meta` readers (`readerOptionLabels`, plugin-email `servedOptionFields`) do.
- The resolve route reads the locale from `Accept-Language` only. It does not add a `?locale=` read, so the route's query surface is unchanged.
- The answer now depends on `Accept-Language`, and `Vary` says so (L2 S1, above). `Cache-Control: no-store` is unchanged.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`, `sharedObjectLabel`: the locale and resolve-option rule.
2. `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts`, the resolve arm: the twin's i18n resolution.
3. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordFields.tsx`, the key filter.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/share-links-field-projection.test.ts`. Expect every test to pass, including the `[#33552]` describes on both mounts (the rename case among them).

<details><summary>Readings, rework round 1, at head 274536590</summary>

- Closure rebuilt under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, all green under `set -e`:
  - types `share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` and `share-password-header.test.ts`: 50/50;
  - runtime `share-links-field-projection`, `share-links-public-cache-headers` and `share-links-password-encoding`: 51/51;
  - plugin-sharing `share-link-password` and `share-link-redact-fields`: 55/55;
  - typecheck passed on types, plugin-sharing and runtime.

- Ablation A deleted the `packagedBase` option line in `sharedObjectLabel`. The types test read the source directly: 1 failed (the rename pin), 16 passed. Restored to the HEAD blob f28a2bdd1f37; `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation B dropped `Accept-Language` from `SHARE_LINK_PUBLIC_VARY`. Types was rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` confirmed the marker gone from dist.
  - The runtime `share-links-public-cache-headers` pins went red: 3 failed, 2 passed.
  - The plugin `never cached` pins went red: 2 failed.
  - Restored to the HEAD blob; the rebuild put the marker back in dist (preflight exit 0); `git diff HEAD` was 0 lines.

</details>

<details><summary>Readings at head 75f97ca66 (round 0; local subset; CI runs the full farm)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types test`: Test Files 39 passed (39), Tests 921 passed (921). Typecheck passed on `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` and `@objectstack/runtime`; the test-typecheck ledgers held. These ran at head 9a0a2b29a, and only a test-file import and the changeset have changed since.
- At 75f97ca66, under the lock (VERDICT command-exit 0): `share-links-field-projection.test.ts` 19/19, `share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` 14/14.
- Console, from `ui/`, under the lock (VERDICT command-exit 0): six share-page files, Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 51 passed (51).
- Ablations: each mutation was made with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirmed the anchor went from 1 to 0, and was restored to the HEAD blob a2ae3fcb6b25.
  - Returning the declared label instead of the translated one: 2 failed, 12 passed. The two failures are the zh-CN case and the default-locale case.
  - Deleting the `hidden` projection line: 1 failed, 13 passed.
  - The console filter was not ablated.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --ran`): 78 derived, 74 run, 4 not measured.
  - The 4 not measured exited 3 (prerequisite not met): the plugin-teardown-shape self-test (shallow clone), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (workspace not fully built), and `check:type-check-debt` (closure build got no turn on the lock).
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 1. Six tests timed out at 15 s with the box at load average 15, and the registry census could not import packages that were not built yet. The call-site-keys gate those timed-out tests drive was run directly (`node ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`, exit 0).
  - `check:test-source-alias` first flagged the edited harness; it was fixed with a module-top `@objectstack/metadata` import and is now exit 0.
